title: Sales by Customer keeps its columns, credits and download headers
refs: SV-11718 (Reports Story 1 S1-R7 S1-E8 Reports Story 4 S4-R6)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging (preferred), or the Tiered Pricing QA site too once the release is deployed there; production is not needed.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, with a $50.00 goodwill credit made on the customer page today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales By Customer.
  2. Pick customer B in the Customer filter.
  3. Download Sales By Customer's CSV.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales By Customer opens with today's filters (Date, Product Type, Customer, Location) and columns, as in the Today picture.

Step 2:

  • Customer B's row shows the $50.00 goodwill credit.
  • The new Sales by Tier figures are not shown on this report.

Step 3:

  • Its CSV headers read as today, including "Margin %".
  • The new name "Parts Margin %" does not appear in this download.
